summary: Tested techfest admin Submissions panel - filters (region/age/track/status), approve/reject with mandatory remarks, duplicate blocking, duplicate flagging on legacy row. All backend tests passed (5/5) and all critical UI flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: SubmissionReviewIn uses field name 'remarks' but UI data-testid is 'admin-submission-review-remarks' and column labelled 'Judge Remarks' - naming is consistent on API side though frontend prop could be unified (minor).
find_duplicate_submission uses regex-escape and whitespace tolerance - good; verified via legacy row 'tf-team-1 ' flagged as duplicate.
Status filter value 'duplicate' (singular) in HTML select but UI label 'Duplicates' - acceptable naming.
seed_data_creation: No new seed; used existing seeded submissions. Note: changed review_status of ZZ-T-777 to 'approved' with remarks 'Great work from test' (via test_review_approve_then_reject_persists), and TF-TEAM-1 (6ab40f21fc0667aceb877bd6) to 'rejected' with remarks 'E2E auto reject reason' (via Playwright UI flow). Main agent can reset these if needed for retests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: 1) Admin login works via /admin/login (NOT /login which routes to learner/school/educator). 2) Submissions tab at /admin/competitions shows 4 rows with Status + Judge Review columns. 3) Filters work (region=North->1, region=West->1, age=senior->1, status=approved->1, status=duplicate->1 w/ dup badge, track filter present). 4) Count text format is 'X of Y submissions' at data-testid=admin-submissions-count. 5) Reject dialog [admin-submission-review-dialog], save button disabled empty, enabled on text, remarks persist. 6) Public POST /api/techfest/submissions returns 409 with full duplicate message for TF-TEAM-1. 7) PATCH review with blank remarks returns 400. Backend review endpoint expects field 'remarks' (not 'judge_remarks') but response returns 'judge_remarks'. All 5 pytest tests pass.
